name: heavy-season
description: Distress fixture: low mood across entries plus a reply flagged distress_flag. The letter must switch to the resources approach (genre 'resources', crisis resources named) instead of the usual persona material.

entries.body: Everything feels heavier lately. I'm not sleeping well and the things I usually look forward to feel gray. I keep cancelling plans and then feeling worse about the cancelling than the plans.
Another day that got away from me. I know I should write more but even this feels like lifting something heavy. The notebook is the one thing I haven't dropped, barely.
I told myself today that rest is not the same as giving up. I'm not sure I believe it yet but I wrote it down, which is something.

replies.body: Honestly, some nights I don't want to be here anymore. I don't know who else to say that to.
